findings.body:
**Defer when the judge’s secret scan fails.**

In `triage.py:180-182`, a `RuntimeError` from the production judge’s secret scan escapes before plans are persisted. A failed Git read of the denylist can discard deterministic plans and earlier judgments, requiring the judgments to run again. Catch the error and stop without calling the model.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-        except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OSError):
+        except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OSError, RuntimeError):
             stopped = 'deferred'; break
```

</details>
findings.title: Defer when the judge’s secret scan fails.

findings.body:
**Search the mapped path after a rename**

In `apps/crq-python/crq_repair/triage.py:33`, an exact rename followed by blame loss can leave `name` mapped but `lines` empty. The fallback then searches the old path. If the matching line is outside the first 41 lines of the renamed file, the judge misses it and may return `unsure` or dismiss a valid finding.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-            search = repo.git('grep', '-n', '-F', '-e', needle[:200], tip, '--', finding['path'], check=False).decode(errors='replace')[:16000]
+            search = repo.git('grep', '-n', '-F', '-e', needle[:200], tip, '--', name, check=False).decode(errors='replace')[:16000]
```

</details>
findings.title: Search the mapped path after a rename

findings.body:
**Restore replay of anchor-refused judgments.**

In `recovery.py:86-91`, an unrelated tip advance makes `recover` reject a saved judgment even when the source and evidence are unchanged. With no tip advance, it returns the unresolved record instead of rechecking it. The replay test therefore fails.

Restore replay only for valid judgments refused by the anchor check. Preserve the source, evidence, full-contract and ancestry checks; do not skip binding checks for other completed or deferred jobs.
findings.title: Restore replay of anchor-refused judgments.

findings.body:
**Accept verified multiline anchors**

In `apps/crq-python/crq_repair/recovery.py:133-136`, a valid judge report can select an exact multiline range containing the finding line. The current check rejects it and saves the recovery as unresolved without preparing a replacement.

Validate one bounded range containing the finding line and compare the quote with the full range:

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
     if (not isinstance(line, int) or isinstance(line, bool) or line < 1 or line > len(lines)
-            or report.get('current_path') != path or selected != [[line, line]]
-            or report.get('quoted_text') != lines[line - 1]
+            or report.get('current_path') != path
+            or not isinstance(selected, list) or len(selected) != 1
+            or not isinstance(selected[0], list) or len(selected[0]) != 2
+            or not all(isinstance(n, int) and not isinstance(n, bool) for n in selected[0])
+            or not (1 <= selected[0][0] <= line <= selected[0][1] <= len(lines))
+            or report.get('quoted_text') != '\n'.join(lines[selected[0][0] - 1:selected[0][1]])
             or not isinstance(report.get('reason'), str) or not report['reason'].strip()):
```

</details>
findings.title: Accept verified multiline anchors
